Questions

Quick answers.

Not here? Send me a message.

The screen stopped responding.
It's probably locked. Tap the padlock at the top. About the lock →
It went dark by itself.
That's normal. It dims after 1 minute and turns off after 10. Tap the screen to wake it.
How do I turn it off?
Tap OFF at the top right of the menu. There's no power switch.
How do I charge it?
Any USB-C phone charger. A cable isn't included.
Why does the battery % move around?
It's estimated from the battery's voltage, which dips while the screen is bright. It can't read the level while charging, so it just says Charging.
Taps land in the wrong place.
Use Fix touch on a computer. Try Reset to factory first.
Can I play on my phone?
Yes, if you own a box. Open Play and enter the code from your box: Info, then tap the arrow until "Play on your phone".
Do I need an app or wifi?
No. The box works on its own. Only the phone version needs internet.
How many players?
3 to 15.
Does the imposter know?
Yes. Their card says IMPOSTER.
Can I add my own words?
Not yet. It has 450 words in 18 categories, and no word repeats within 16 rounds.
How do I get new versions?
Update it from a computer. Your settings stay as they are.
Something's broken.
Tell me and I'll fix it.

Safety and care

  • It has a built-in lithium battery. Don't crush, puncture or open the case.
  • Keep it dry. It isn't water resistant.
  • Don't leave it in a hot car or direct sun.
  • Don't leave it charging unattended. Slightly warm while charging is normal; if it gets hot, unplug it and message me.
  • For ages 10 and up.
